mapper.select: SELECT b.tenant_id::text AS tenantId, a.agent_id::text AS agentId, a.name AS name, a.description AS description, (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_version v WHERE v.agent_id = a.agent_id) AS versionCount, av.version_number AS latestVersionNumber, av.published_at AS latestPublishedAt, tc.tenant_count AS tenantCount FROM tenant_agent_binding b JOIN agent a ON a.agent_id = b.agent_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT v.version_number, v.published_at FROM agent_version v WHERE v.agent_id = a.agent_id ORDER BY v.version_number DESC LIMIT 1 ) av ON TRUE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT agent_id, count(*) AS tenant_count FROM tenant_agent_binding WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY agent_id ) tc ON tc.agent_id = a.agent_id WHERE b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (#{tenantIdFilter}::uuid IS NULL OR b.tenant_id = #{tenantIdFilter}::uuid) ORDER BY b.tenant_id, a.name, a.agent_id
